# Bibliography typography

`IEEEtran.bst` is the unmodified IEEEtran 1.14 source with its original license
and credits. `../archsync-ieee.bst` is a separately named typography variant:
straight double quotes and a single hyphen for repeated author names only.
`scripts/verify-bibliography-style.mjs` checks the pinned original SHA-256 and
the exact allowed transformation. This is not an official IEEE style release
or a certification of compliance with an unselected venue.
